# Karim Khamis — Full-Stack & Mobile Developer

> Full-stack and mobile developer based in Cairo, Egypt. Specializing in React, React Native, Python/Django, and AI-integrated applications. Available for freelance projects and full-time roles worldwide.

## About

Karim Khamis is a full-stack and mobile software developer with 3+ years of freelance experience (30+ projects, 100% on-time delivery). He holds a B.Sc. in Software Engineering from Ain Shams University (2022, GPA 3.2/4.0) and is pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering at AASTMT (expected 2028), with research focused on OCR and multilingual document processing.

He completed an internship as a Full-Stack Developer at The Address Company (Jan–Jun 2025) and currently works as a Graduate Researcher in OCR at AASTMT (Jul 2025–present).

## Flagship Projects

### Letra — Cross-Platform OCR Mobile App
Custom-trained OCR application for iOS and Android built with React Native (Expo), TensorFlow/Keras, and PaddleOCR. Achieves 98% English character recognition accuracy. Deployed to TestFlight and Google Play Beta.

### Qodrateman — E-Learning Platform
Full-stack e-learning platform at qodrateman.com. Built with React, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, and JWT authentication. Features 12+ courses and AI-powered quiz generation in under 30 seconds.
